notes.title: New level and enemy update!
notes.notes:
We have added a new level and enemy!
Also to make it a little challenging we added 2 new achievements. Both have to be completed within a certain amount of time. Good luck!

Like always let me know what you think and when you find bugs, please report it to me.

notes.title: Small graphics update
notes.notes:
Today I updated the game with a few visual upgrades.
Also I changed the jump key to spacebar so now when using walljump just press spacebar to do a walljump!

Added the new Blob From Space theme!

Let me know what you think of the walljump with spacebar. If people like this better I will keep this one ingame.

Happy gaming,
ːjosː

notes.title: New Blob From Space update tomorrow!
notes.notes:
[img]https://josweb.info/images/BFS/Tutorial14-3-2015.jpg[/img]
Tomorrow I will upload a new Blob From Space update. This has a new tutorial level including the wall jump (see picture).

The first level after the wall jump will have only 1 enemy (The flyer) and it will teach you the flying mechanics.

[b]NOTE:[/b] The flyer graphics will have some bugs. We are trying hard to fix it, but we can't keep you guys from this next update tomorrow, because we do want to show you we're working hard on this game.

Have fun,
ːjosː

notes.title: 1 November update
notes.notes:
As some of you already have seen we added Steam cloud.
At this moment Steam cloud will save your Diamond Rush highscore and the settings. So where ever you go you can keep practising to beat your Diamond Rush highscore. We also need Steam cloud to work with the level select. So you don't have to repeat the levels over and over whereever you are.

We also added some smooth camera movement in the game and there is a way to use different camera settings. You can play from a big distance (Use the F1 button) or play with closeup (F2).

We also edit some new images and animations.

Hope you like this small update.
ːjosː
